title: Worth the price for something simple and easy
text: Worth the price for something simple and easy. Extremely easy to install. Perfect to just cover the under part of the bed. Looks much nicer than all the crap I have under my bed. Great for the money.

product_metadata.title: AYASW Bed Skirt Twin Size 16 inch Drop Dust Ruffle Soft and Cozy 1800 Brushed Microfiber Three Fabric Sides Wrap Around with Elastic No Top Easy On Pink
features: SIZE: 39x75 inches with 15~16 inches long. It's suitable for Twin size (39x 75in), XL Twin(39x 80in) beds. Please use an iron to smooth out the wrinkles when using it for the first time.

SPECIAL: Adjustable elastic for one inch trimmed ruffle makes it easy to put on and take off your bed. It's smartly designed with two Elastic band and three fabric sides, which help you fit it fastly and you won’t even need to lift the mattress.
MATERIAL: Special Brushed Fabric with Beautiful Ruffles is structural durability. It's wrap around for three sides and without a top cover.
CLEAN: Machine wash on delicate light and use a laundry bag to protect; tumble dry on low. Used a steam iron on a low setting before the first use.
